newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices ease at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices ease at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were easier at the weekly auction in Mombasa, auction officials said on Monday.
Brighter and Medium BP1s eased by 3-5 U.S cents while Brighter and Medium PF1s eased by 20-40 cents. Brighter PDUSTs lost up to 20 cents while Brighter DUST1s were irregular.
In the secondary catalogues, Fannings and BMFs were irregularly easier.
Pakistan blenders were very active while Egypt and other Middle East countries lent good support.
